glosses: national, nationwide (of or relating to a nation)

examples.text: Está prohibido cazar en los parques nacionales.
examples.en: Hunting is banned in national parks.

examples.text: El lunes próximo es fiesta nacional.
examples.en: Next Monday is a national holiday.
